name: systemd-update-utmp.service
exact_quotes: settings that are in force only inside one program, for example the home page, theme, and extensions of a web browser. […] A file that a program executes as code counts as code even when it holds settings; a file that a program only reads as values counts as a setting; […] Whatever the computer’s behaviour depends on—what it does and what can be done on it—must be recorded. […] The test is removal: if, after an object is removed, the computer stops doing something or something becomes impossible on it, the object must be recorded.
review_reason: The inventory object is a managed unit; replacing it by its fragment file chooses an unstated object reading. That reading remains unresolved, not refuted. Available row/fragment and unit-file-state evidence does not establish the exact file section contents and all applying programs. [Install] can be applied by systemctl; no claim that every file has operative [Install] values. No confirmed single-program premise.
